artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns Speaking with His Mother
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals: one seen from the back with a muscular build, wearing a crown of thorns and shoulder-length wavy hair, unclothed from the waist up, and the other facing forward with delicate features, wrapped hands, and wearing a headscarf. The person on the left stands in front, with a hand on their chest, and the setting shows a simple ledge or platform. Radiant lines emerge from behind the person on the right. The artwork is monochromatic, featuring fine linework for texture and shading.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Large Apostles"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel holding a scroll. The angel is depicted with flowing hair and delicate features, holding the top of a large scroll with both hands. The scroll contains Latin text, prominently displaying "SALVATORIS BEATÆ" and other lines. The angel appears to be elevated against a background with clouds or wings. Below the scroll lies an assortment of weapons and tools, including a spear, sword, and a large key. The composition is detailed with fine lines and intricate shading.

artworks.title: Christ
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. The person has long, wavy hair and a beard, with sharp and expressive facial features. They are wearing a long robe with a belt at the waist and a cloak over the shoulders. The right hand is raised with the index and middle fingers pointing upwards, while the left hand holds an orb topped with a cross. The background features a landscape with hills and small human figures, including one holding a cross and others in motion. An aura or halo is depicted around the person's head.

artworks.title: The Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with hands together in a prayerful gesture. The individual has a calm expression and wears long robes with a headdress covering their hair. A halo surrounds the person's head. In the background, there are other figures, clouds, and riders on horseback among foliage.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright holding a large book in his hands. He appears older with a beard and unkempt hair, wearing a long robe. He also holds a set of keys in his left hand. In the background, there are smaller figures interacting and workers near a boat with a sail. The style of the image is reminiscent of an engraving with detailed linework and shading.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a beard, furrowed brows, deeply set eyes, high forehead, and wavy hair. He wears a robe, holds a sword in his right hand, and has a halo above his head. The background includes figures on horseback and a town or fortress.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure holding two large logs and a bundled cloth in his left arm, while his right arm holds another set of logs. His head is turned slightly to his left, and he is gazing into the distance. The figure has long, wavy hair and a full beard, with distinct facial features such as a prominent nose and furrowed brow. He is dressed in a loose, flowing robe tied at the waist, and the cloth draped over his left arm hangs down towards his feet, alongside two fish that he holds by their tails. In the background, there are two scenes: on the left, two smaller figures appear to be struggling with a large wooden structure, while on the right, a crowd gathers around someone standing on a platform. The style is a detailed black and white engraving with a sense of depth and texture in the clothing and objects.

artworks.title: Saint James the Great
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, slightly turned to the left, looking ahead. The person has a long beard, long wavy hair, and is wearing a robe and a round hat with a cross. They hold a staff with an orb-shaped top. The background has classical architectural elements and groups of people engaging in various activities.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a relaxed posture, facing slightly left with their gaze directed upwards. The individual has long, wavy hair and a youthful face. They are wearing flowing robes that cover their body and bare feet. The figure is holding a goblet with branches emerging from it. A halo-like circle surrounds their head. In the background, a group of people under an archway are engaged in an activity. A smaller figure is depicted kneeling near a tree or rock formation. The background is monochrome with detailed shading and line work.

artworks.title: Saint James the Less
artworks.description: The image is of a standing person with long hair and a beard, wearing a long robe. They are holding a staff in their right hand and a book or tablet in their left arm. A halo encircles the person's head. In the background are grand structures and small figures engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure in a pose, with a halo around their head. The figure has a beard and slightly furrowed brow, with wavy and receding hair, dressed in long robes. They hold a staff in one hand and an open book in the other. On the left is an illustration of a street with people and buildings. On the right, smaller haloed figures are beneath trees.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, facing forward with slight body turn, holding an open book in their left hand and a long staff with a cross on top in their right hand. There is a halo around their head, and they have detailed facial features. They have wavy hair, wearing long robes that reveal bare feet. The background includes architectural structures, statues, and a crowd of figures engaged in various activities. The image is in a classic etching style with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing upright, draped in flowing robes. He has a long beard and hair, both flowing and slightly wavy. A halo surrounds his head. The man's facial expression is calm. He wears a detailed robe with one hand resting on his chest and the other holding a knife. The scene around him includes smaller figures engaged in various activities against a backdrop of classical architecture.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias
artworks.description: The image features a full-body illustration of a person standing in profile, facing right. The person has a halo around their head, long wavy hair covering the forehead and part of the face, a serious expression, a long nose, and a prominent brow. They wear flowing robes with intricate patterns, hold a book in their right hand, and a staff in their left. The background shows architectural structures, arches, and several smaller figures engaged in different activities, creating a busy city scene. The drawing style is detailed with emphasized texture and depth.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: The image features an elderly man standing with a crutch, holding an open book and gazing thoughtfully. He has a pointed nose, a contemplative expression, and a halo around his head. He has a bald head with a tuft of hair, wearing a long, flowing garment. He stands barefoot on a paved surface. In the background, a group of people is gathered in a street between buildings, one with columns.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a man standing and facing slightly to the right. He is depicted in profile with a beard and tousled hair. The man is dressed in a long robe with deep folds, holding a staff in front of his body. He has a halo around his head. The background includes architectural elements like columns and statues, with smaller figures interacting near a structure, and trees are also visible. The image is a line drawing with detailed clothing and environment.

artworks.title: Saint Thaddeus
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing prominently in the foreground. He is holding a large axe, with one hand placed on his chest. He has long hair and a beard and is wearing a long robe and cloak. Around him is an architectural cityscape with various buildings. In the background are smaller figures engaged in different activities, suggesting a bustling city scene. The image has a textured, illustrated quality with lines and shading.

artworks.title: Vue generale des Alpes et Glaciers
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a fountain in the foreground, people strolling around it. In the background, there are mountains with snow-capped peaks and a castle on a hill. The painting style is realistic with fine brushstrokes, featuring earthy tones and pale blues and whites in the sky and mountains.

artworks.title: Vue de Schadau
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view overlooking a lake with a castle-like structure on a peninsula. Mountains are visible on the horizon, and the landscape is detailed with trees, buildings, and distant mountains. The color palette is subtle with pastel hues. Figures and animals are depicted in the foreground, and boats are on the lake.

artworks.title: The Cook and His Wife
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman, with their entire bodies depicted from head to toe. The man is standing on the left, with his body slightly turned towards the woman on his right. He is facing slightly towards her with an open mouth. His facial features include a nose, full cheeks, and short, curly hair. He wears a simple, fitted outfit with visible patches and repairs on the knee area of his trousers. He holds a pair of kitchen utensils in his right hand and has a dagger tucked into his belt. The woman stands next to him with her arms folded across her midsection. Her face is turned slightly towards the left with a composed expression. She has delicate features and small lips, with a headscarf tied back. She is dressed in a long gown with layered fabric, wearing an ornate necklace. In the background, there is minimalistic scenery with a blank ground beneath their feet and a flat ground in the distance, emphasizing the two figures.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with the Three Hares
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child in her lap, while a man stands beside them. The woman has long, wavy hair under a headdress. The child appears to be reaching out playfully, with curly hair. The man has a long beard and is dressed in robes. Both the woman and the man wear detailed garments. Two angels fly above, holding a crown. The background shows hills, trees, a castle, and rabbits on the ground. Various plants surround the figures.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows with Hands Bound
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright with his head slightly tilted to the side. His hands are crossed at his waist. He has a solemn expression on his face, with a full beard and curly hair falling to his shoulders. He wears a crown of thorns. His upper body is bare, revealing a muscular chest, while a draped garment covers the lower part of his body. Beside him is a gnarled, leafless tree to his right. The backdrop features a simple landscape with undulating terrain and distant hills, creating a desolate outdoor setting. To the left of the man, there is a faint sketch of landforms on the ground, with a small inscription at the top left corner of the image.

artworks.title: A Turkish Horseman
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body profile of a person riding a horse. The individual is seated on the horse, facing away from the viewer, with the horse rearing up slightly. The person's facial features are not visible due to the position, but their hair is styled in waves, and they are wearing a turban with a plume. The clothing consists of a loose-fitting garment, possibly a robe or cloak, which is gathered around the waist with a belt. The horse is adorned with a saddle and harness. The rider carries a sword in a scabbard on their back, and a lance with a flag attached to it. The flag bears a crescent moon and star emblem. The background shows some grass and a few plants on the ground, with no other objects or structures visible.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Solomon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.1 × 22.2 cm (5 15/16 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with various figures engaged in discussion. The artwork shows a grand hall or chamber with classical architectural features like columns and arches. In the center, a seated figure gestures while addressing a group of standing and kneeling figures. The scene includes nude figures and a child near the seated figure. The background is detailed with symmetrical elements, shading is used to create depth and texture.
